Market today: The mood is shaky, driven by the Nvidia news. This is the real driver for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: CRWD (24% gain) and SPY (0.12% gain) are marked SELL. SMCI (-34% loss) and SOXL (-79% loss) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs like SOXL and PLTU. Their decay is a constant drag, especially when the market turns.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your existing positions, especially the leveraged ones, given the current market uncertainty.
plays: Trim CRWD: Consider taking some profit on CRWD given its SELL status and the current market jitters.
Watch SMCI: Monitor SMCI closely. Its stop is 37.3, but the deep losses suggest caution.
No new buys today - hold and watch
